title: CLI.0.2 performance baseline
limitations: Single development workstation; no controlled thermal/background workload
Synthetic audit history repeats a complete checkpoint and is not a real long run
GameSnapshotter method timings exclude UiBridge; codec/store snapshots include complete Controller UI maps
Component quantiles from separate stages/JVMs must not be summed into pipe latency

scenarios.game_inputs: public NDJSON only; no screenshots, native keys, mouse, or computer use
scenarios.latency_scope: Python request encode/write through matching complete NDJSON response decode; includes scheduling, all audit transactions and pipe I/O

capture.boundary: render thread; exact Actor handoff monitor in GameScene; no SQLite transaction in probe
capture.capture_scope: GameSnapshotter.capture including public projection, graph/static roots, RNG, declared profile files, build catalog; excludes UiBridge and protocol
capture.exported_snapshot_scope: Exact complete GameController state from the last settled CLI observation, including UiBridge; codec and audit benchmarks use these unmodified maps

audit.synthetic_history_model: Repeated complete state.get records from one real fixture checkpoint, not a long game or evolving history
